rumour.settlement: There's a town called {other}, about {distance} blocks {direction} of here.
Follow the road {direction} a good {distance} blocks and you'll come to {other}.
{other} lies {direction}, {distance} blocks or so. Friendly enough, if you don't haggle.

rumour.settlement.text: My cousin lives in {other}, {direction} of here. Tell her I said hello.
{other}? {direction}, about {distance} blocks. Bad bread, worse beer.
The couriers say {other}, {distance} blocks {direction}, is growing fast.

rumour.landmark: They say there's a {landmark} out {direction}, maybe {distance} blocks.
Travellers talk of a {landmark}, {distance} blocks {direction} of here.

rumour.landmark.text: There's a {landmark} {direction} of here, {distance} blocks off. I've always wanted to see it.
Stay away from the {landmark} {direction} of here. Nothing good comes of poking at old places.
A {landmark}, {distance} blocks {direction}. Bring back a tale and I'll buy you a drink.

rumour.none: I've never been further than the edge of the fields, truth be told.
Couldn't tell you what's out there. Ask a courier.

rumour.none.text: Out there? Wolves, mostly. And worse at night.
